params.body:
The first real event in the dataset (the opening on 30 October) showed where the site breaks on what an owner actually types: a whole sentence as title with hand-spaced letters, a summary and body that repeat it, a start time left at the moment of entry, and a slug of `.`. This makes the site hold up with that input and makes good input the easy path in the Studio.

## Bugs

- **Times in the build machine's zone.** `toLocaleTimeString` without a `timeZone` ran in UTC on Netlify, so an event entered at 16:26 showed "vanaf 15:26". All formatting now uses `Europe/Brussels`.
- **Slug `.`.** The live event's slug is `.`; built from main, `getStaticPaths` writes it to `/agenda/index.html`, over the agenda. `eventSlug()` now falls back to a slug made from the title, and the event page is looked up by `_id`. The Studio rejects slugs that are not lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

## Design

- Lining figures on `html`: Cormorant's default old-style figures made "30" read as "3o" and "17" as "I7" (titles, the phone number, 1905).
- Event titles: whitespace collapsed, hand-spaced letters joined ("O P E N I N G" becomes "OPENING"), and the size steps down for medium and long titles.
- Event page: date and time in one line ("vrijdag 30 oktober, vanaf 17 uur"), no Caveat date, no arrow, no double rule. Summary and long description are hidden when they repeat the title (`repeats()` in `src/lib/eventText.ts`, at 75% word overlap).
- Agenda list: same title handling, date in Source Serif instead of a second Cormorant voice, summary only when it adds something.
- Page content aligned with the header's wide container; reading measure kept with `max-w` on the text.
- Footer opening hours sorted Monday first (they were in entry order).

## Studio (`event` schema)

- Title: short-title hint with an example; warnings above 40 characters, for spaced letters, and for a date or hour in the title.
- Start and end: `DD-MM-YYYY`, `HH:mm`, 15-minute step. Warning when the minutes are not on a quarter hour (looks like the moment of entry), and when the start date differs from a date written in the title.
- Korte beschrijving: described as only for what the title does not say; warning when it repeats the title.

## Checked

- `astro build` against the live dataset (read only) and `tsc --noEmit`, both clean.
- Phone and desktop screenshots of every page before and after, plus the event page and agenda rendered with suggested content (title "Opening", start 30 October 17:00, one summary line) through a local patch that is not in this branch.
- Not checked: the Studio form itself, which needs a login.

No content was written to Sanity.
params.title: Event pages that hold up with what the owner types
